title: Radiant Boost
description: A lightweight Modpack built to boost Minecraft up to 300+ FPS on low-end PCs.

# Description :
- This modpack is built for players who want maximum FPS, smooth gameplay, and clean visuals on low-end and mid-range PCs.
With a carefully selected set of performance mods, this pack boosts your game to 300+ FPS, reduces stuttering, and improves world loading without removing the vanilla feeling.

- Every mod inside the pack is chosen to optimize rendering, memory usage, chunk loading, and CPU performance—while still keeping compatibility with shaders and quality-improving add-ons.

# Features :
- Rendering Boosters – Speeds up frame rendering for smoother gameplay and higher FPS.

- GPU Optimization Layer – Reduces graphics load and improves performance on low-end and integrated GPUs.

- Advanced Chunk Loading – Faster and smoother world loading with fewer stutters.

- Network & Ping Tweaks – Improved connection handling for more stable ping and reduced packet loss.

- Lightweight Visual Enhancements – Better lighting, cleaner textures, and smooth animations without losing performance.

- RAM & CPU Efficiency – Smarter memory usage and reduced CPU spikes for a stable experience.

- Faster Startup Times – Shorter loading screens and quicker world generation.

- Input & Control Upgrades – Mouse Tweaks, better scrolling, improved tool handling, and refined player interactions.

- Brightness & Visibility Tools – Built-in gamma utilities for clearer vision in caves and nighttime.

- UI & HUD Refinements – Clean, minimal, and responsive interface for better readability.

- Shader Compatibility – Works with lightweight shaders for improved visuals.

- Crash & Lag Prevention – Stability-focused mods to avoid freezes or sudden slowdowns.

- Low-End Friendly – Fully optimized for old laptops, office PCs, and integrated graphics.

- Over 50+ Curated Mods – A complete, balanced pack combining performance, visuals, and QoL enhancements.

# Compatibilities :
- Supports most lightweight shader packs, including Iris-compatible shaders.

- Works on low-end, mid-range, and integrated GPU systems with no extra setup.

- Runs smoothly with common launcher setups like Modrinth, CurseForge, ATLauncher ...

- Optimized for laptops, office PCs, and older hardware with limited resources.

- Safe to use in multiplayer—no gameplay-changing or unfair advantage mods included.

# Goal & Vision :
- Goal:
To deliver the smoothest and fastest Minecraft experience possible on any low-end or mid-range PC, while keeping the game visually clean, stable, and enjoyable.

- Vision:
A modpack that proves you don’t need a powerful PC to enjoy high FPS, beautiful visuals, low ping, and a responsive gameplay experience.
A pack built for players who want performance first, without sacrificing quality, compatibility, or the vanilla feel.

# Credits :

All the amazing mod developers whose work makes this pack possible.
Every optimization, visual upgrade, and QoL improvement comes from the talent and dedication of the Minecraft modding community.
